newsitem.title: UK: MEPC sells properties for 13 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: MEPC sells properties for 13 mln stg.

text.p: MEPC Plc on Thursday said it sold had seven industrial estates in Scotland to Haslemere Estates, on behalf of Rodamco UK, for a total of 13.1 million stg.
Rodamco UK is managed by Haslemere and is a subsidiary of Dutch investment house Rodamco NV's Roadamco Europe.
The sale of the Scottish properties follows MEPC's acquisition of Caledonian Land Ltd in July.

"We were disappointed not to succeed with our bid to purchase Cadedonian Land, but were happy to find that MEPC felt in a position to sell us seven of the estates that we most wanted to buy from the Caledonian portfolio," Haslemere managing director Chris Bartram said in a statement.
"We believe these have good reversionary prospects over the next few years."
